stem: Which abdominal X-ray finding is linked to ascites rather than obstruction?

options.text: Lines and tubes in expected position

explanation: Gasless abdomen is the correct answer because it is associated with ascites rather than bowel obstruction on abdominal X-ray.

citations.source: Louisa Leone MD3 2025 - Child and Adolescent Health - Study Notes.pdf
citations.title: Page 196

optionExplanations.A: Correct because a gasless abdomen is linked with ascites.
optionExplanations.B: Incorrect because dilated small bowel loops suggest obstruction rather than ascites.
optionExplanations.C: Incorrect because a mosaic pattern in a neonate is not the finding linked to ascites here.
optionExplanations.D: Incorrect because the football sign indicates free intraperitoneal gas, not ascites.
optionExplanations.E: Incorrect because lines and tubes in expected position are not the abnormal finding linked to ascites.
